playbooks.pivot: Run a passive-pivots checklist before concluding data is absent: WHOIS, historical DNS, Wayback, key-page extraction (About/Contact/Services), targeted social search, and public registry search.
playbooks.when_to_use: Whenever surface expansion has only a seed (e.g. just the domain) and no new asset has been derived.

playbooks.pivot: Explicitly separate observed facts, hypotheses, and gaps across all modules, propagating a 'confidence' field for fast triage of evidence strength.
playbooks.when_to_use: In any collection or analysis module, to avoid extrapolation and filling gaps with assumption.

playbooks.pivot: Declare in the output which passive pivots were performed (performed_pivots) and which were skipped with a reason (skipped_pivots), instead of only listing recommended pivots without executing them.
playbooks.when_to_use: In surface expansion and correlation, to make what was actually done auditable.
